sections.title: Days spent on plumbing
body: Every new app needs sign-in, sessions that work on both server and browser, protected pages and roles. It is rarely the product, yet it eats days, and small mistakes in it are security bugs.
sections.caption: Five auth layers revealed beneath the sign-in form.

sections.title: A drop-in auth framework for SvelteKit
body: Kavach gives you one API across auth platforms, declarative route protection and pre-built UI components, with full TypeScript types and unified session handling on server and client.

code.text:
sv create my-app && cd my-app
bunx @kavach/cli init   # guided setup
bun run dev

sections.caption: The Kavach shield mark for SvelteKit apps.

sections.title: Minutes, not days
body: The guided CLI wires the hooks and config for you, so the time goes into your product instead of into redirects.
points: Server and client sessions in step
